coupling: With PCRE2_EXTENDED, whitespace is skipped before an automatic callout is emitted, but max_parsed_pattern() still reserves a literal plus a 4-word callout for every pattern unit. PCRE2_AUTO_CALLOUT then adds one trailing callout and META_END, so a pattern of only letters and a single space is given exactly five spare uint32 slots after the META_END store, in an exact heap block once the estimate exceeds PARSED_PATTERN_DEFAULT_SIZE. The callout commit writes four words at parsed_pattern[1..4] and sets after_manual_callout, which the final-callout post-decrement has just cleared; that uses four of the five spare slots and stays in bounds alone. The coverage commit writes four words at offset 1, or at offset 3 when that flag is still set. Alone the flag is clear, so it also stays inside the five slots; with the flag the write reaches offset 6, one past the block. The comment commit subtracts 2 from parsed_size_needed for the same patterns, leaving three spare slots. META_END still fits, but either four-word store then hits offset 4, one past the shrunk block. The existing parsed_pattern >= parsed_pattern_end test guards only the META_END store. Dropping any one of these three diffs leaves a crashing pair (the two stores together, or either store with the smaller buffer), so the overflow cannot be removed by repairing a single commit's diff: the shared slack is consumed both by the tail stores in parse_regex and by the size estimate in pcre2_compile.
